title: Lane and task-record PR bodies use the one PR body section set
body: Evidence 2026-11-18 (t-zvgxegd, PR cbd169e): `krn pr body` now writes the sections Why / What changed / Verified / Task, but src/cli/lane-run/delivery.ts and src/task/pending.ts still write Problem/Change/Verification headings for lane and task-record PRs, so PR bodies are not uniform.
Outcome: every PR body KRN writes (lead, lane, task-record publish) uses the one section set owned by the PR-body module; no second heading list exists.
Proof: a test renders a lane PR body and a task-record PR body and asserts the same section headings as `krn pr body`; a grep test finds no Problem/Change/Verification heading in src/.
